description: Convert an SVG file (Figma/Illustrator export, icon, illustration) into Rive bezier path shapes — the professional way to get high-quality artwork instead of drawing with primitives. Writes a scene-fragment JSON (shapes with full cubic vertices, gradients, strokes) and returns a rendered preview. Use the fragment in riv_create via "imports". Supports path/rect/circle/ellipse/polygon/polyline/line, nested transforms, style attrs, linear/radial gradients. Not imported: <text> (use texts[] with a font), <image>, filters, masks.

idPrefix.description: Prefix for generated shape ids (avoid collisions)

name: riv_import_svg
title: Import an SVG as Rive vector shapes
